fields.label: Administrators
fields.help: Domain user accounts to be added to the local Administrators group of the SMB service.

fields.label: Aes Encryption
fields.help: Enables AES-128 and AES-256 encryption for Kerberos-based communication with Active Directory.

fields.label: Backup Operators
fields.help: Domain user/group accounts to be added to the Backup Operators group of the SMB service.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: DNS
fields.help: Comma separated list of DNS server IP addresses for the Active Directory domain.

fields.label: Domain
fields.help: Fully qualified domain name for the Active Directory domain.

fields.label: Encrypt Dc Connections
fields.help: If enabled, traffic between the SMB server to Domain Controller (DC) will be encrypted.

fields.label: Kdc Hostname
fields.help: Hostname of the Active Directory server used as Kerberos Key Distribution Center.

fields.label: Kdc IP
fields.help: IP address of the Active Directory server used as Kerberos Key Distribution Center.

fields.label: Ldap Signing
fields.help: Specifies whether or not the LDAP traffic needs to be signed.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Name of the region for the policy to apply to.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The resource name of the Active Directory pool.

fields.label: Net Bios Prefix
fields.help: NetBIOS name prefix of the server to be created.

fields.label: Nfs Users With Ldap
fields.help: Local UNIX users on clients without valid user information in Active Directory are blocked from access to LDAP enabled volumes.

fields.label: Organizational Unit
fields.help: Name of the Organizational Unit where you intend to create the computer account for NetApp Volumes.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: Password for specified username.

fields.label: Security Operators
fields.help: Domain accounts that require elevated privileges such as 'SeSecurityPrivilege' to manage security logs.

fields.label: Site
fields.help: Specifies an Active Directory site to manage domain controller selection.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Username for the Active Directory account with permissions to create the compute account within the specified organizational unit.
